description: Enhanced configuration parsing cases covering unrelated YAML, explicit empty filters, and mixed filter ordering.

input.yaml:
target:
  registry: mirror.example.com
copy:
  policy: delayed

source:
  filters:
    - jmespath: "container.name == 'api'"
    - jmespath: "contains(container.image, 'redis')"
    - jmespath: "obj.metadata.namespace == 'prod'"
extra: ignored
